headline: Big Money Doesn't 'Overreact'... Domestic Stock Share Stays in the 70% Range
summary: High-net-worth individuals have kept domestic stocks at an average of 73–76% of their holdings each month this year, despite a market adjustment in the second half. The finding is from Financial News.
why: Wealthy investors' allocation to domestic equities is a gauge of local risk appetite and can influence flows in the Korean stock market.
